verdict.rationale: Versioned, reviewable, roll-back-able automations (such as versioned auth hooks or actions) are a fair capability for an auth/user-management platform to offer, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents Clerk letting users version, review, or roll back automations. The Admin Logs audit trail is an adjacent feature, not automation versioning or rollback, and one community report says Clerk lacks versioning of console settings.
